_comment: TEST 08 -- Berryessa window 15 -> 45 min: the Barkan/Kobek 'plausible' envelope.
2022, quoting Kobek): 'a very large Renaissance fair ran the weekend of the
murder, an hour and a half drive from Lake Berryessa... It was plausible for
Doerr to be there.' If the faire opened ~4pm and Doerr left at opening, the
1.5 h drive lands him at the lake ~5:30; attack ~6:15 -> up to ~45 min slack
(park, walk, change into costume, wait). Win=45 = maximum pre-attack slack
consistent with the faire schedule. Complementary to test 05 (win=25).
NOTE: window change -> Berryessa field + pieces rebuild (~1-2 min first run).
